overview.text: Susan Moore is a retired English teacher. She says that during her nearly two decades at La Cañada High School, she taught all grade levels, including Honors and AP Literature, and served as department chair, on the school site council, and as the founding Diamond Award coach for the school's debate program. She previously worked in entertainment and ran a business.
